commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante.
90+4' Handball by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
90+3' Ivan Romero (Levante) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+3' Matias Moreno (Levante) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
90+2' The linesman makes the right call and Levante will have a corner.
90+2' Ivan Romero (Levante) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but David Soria leaps out to thwart his attempt.
90+2' Ivan Romero (Levante) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+1' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Sebastian Boselli (Getafe) gets booked.
90+1' A second caution from Alejandro Quintero for Zaid Romero (Getafe) means that he has to leave the pitch early today. It's a red card.
90+1' Zaid Romero (Getafe) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! Penalty awarded! Levante will take a penalty kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
87' Here's the change. Carlos Espi leaves the pitch and Alan Matturro (Levante) comes on as a substitute.
87' Patricio Moreno Ruiz prepares a substitution. Djene is replaced by Sebastian Boselli (Getafe).
86' That's the end of the game for Kiko Femenia, who is replaced by Abu Kamara (Getafe).
86' Ivan Romero (Levante) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' 1 - 0 Carlos Espi (Levante) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the left post.
80' A yellow card for a tackle by Kiko Femenia (Getafe). Alejandro Quintero doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
79' Iborra Vicente has decided to make a change. Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) replaces Kareem Tunde.

78' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) has received a yellow card for his foul.
73' Kareem Tunde (Levante) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
71' Patricio Moreno Ruiz decides to make a substitution. Abdel Abqar will be replaced by Davinchi (Getafe).
70' It's time for a substitution. Veljko Birmancevic (Getafe) comes on in place of Adrian Liso.
69' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Carlos Espi (Levante), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort.
68' The attendance is 18155.
63' Vicente Iborra has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kervin Arriaga (Levante) replacing Ugo Raghouber.
63' Substitution. Carlos Alvarez (Levante) on for Pablo Martinez Andres.
61' Penalty saved! Dela (Levante) sends the penalty towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
61' Dela (Levante) is going to take the penalty!
60' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle and signals a foul after Domingos Duarte (Getafe) brought his opponent down. It's a penalty to Levante! Let's see who's going to take it.
59' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
58' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Djene (Getafe) for a tough tackle.
55' Substitution. Mario Martin (Getafe) has come on for Luis Vazquez.
55' Carlos Espi (Levante) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
53' Ivan Romero (Levante) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Alejandro Quintero ignores the protests.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Martin Satriano (Getafe) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

39' Dela (Levante) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but David Soria pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
36' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
35' Kareem Tunde (Levante) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Levante have a corner.
34' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
33' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' The shot by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mathew Ryan.
28' A goal, which was scored by Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante), was disallowed due to offside.

25' Matias Moreno (Levante) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His precise header looks to be going inside the right post, but David Soria is alert and somehow manages to keep the ball out.
25' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Levante.
25' Kareem Tunde (Levante) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
22' A pass by Kiko Femenia (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
17' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Confusion here but it seems that referee Alejandro Quintero has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Carlos Espi (Levante) to a yellow.

10' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Carlos Espi (Levante), but referee Alejandro Quintero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
8' It's a red card! Carlos Espi (Levante) can't believe his eyes as he is being sent off by the referee.
7' Ugo Raghouber (Levante) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
6' Kareem Tunde (Levante) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. His attempt lacked a few centimetres to make it home as it crashed against the crossbar!
5' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.

3' That didn't go as planned! Ivan Romero (Levante) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past David Soria, who easily kept it out.
